Butternut Squash Soup|A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.|1 serving|20 mins|see directions|Sauté onions and garlic, add cubed butternut squash and broth. Puree until smooth and season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
